$comment: Surfaces fixed in place while still unconverted, under the urgent-fix escape in AGENTS.md.
A debt ledger, not a permit. It obeys the rule every other baseline in this repository obeys:
the only edit is downward. A row leaves by the surface becoming an extension — never because
somebody decided the debt had aged out.
A surface already listed here may not take the escape a second time. One emergency is an
emergency; two is a plan, and a plan does not need an escape hatch.
Each row: the surface, the date, what was urgent, and which file carries the comment at the site.
